title: Extension from an ideal-power submodule over a fixed complement
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian quasi-compact scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], I a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, F a quasi-coherent module, and G a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent]. For n >= 0 use the image-defined product I^n G [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk], with its inclusion j_n into G. Let U be any open whose points are exactly those where the stalk inclusion I_x -> O_X,x is surjective. Every O_U-linear map psi:G|U -> F|U extends from some I^n G: there exist n >= 0 and chi:I^n G -> F with j_n|U followed by psi equal to chi|U [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Only this finite-stage surjectivity is asserted, not injectivity or a colimit comparison.

proof.text: Identify the given open with the complement of I.support. Apply the closed-immersion clause of quasi_coherent_ideal_zero_set_affine to I.subschemeι, use ker_subschemeι and range_subschemeι, and rewrite nonsurjectivity as nonmembership in U using hU. Package the given locally Noetherian and compact hypotheses as IsNoetherian X.

proof.text: Transport ψ from overFunctor to restrictFunctor U.ι by conjugation with overFunctorEquiv U and the functor overEquiv U. Apply coherent_open_map_tensor_extension to obtain n and β : (I^n).toModules tensor G → F whose restriction is multiplication followed by the transported ψ.

proof.text: Apply ideal_power_tensor_image_lift to obtain m and a : (I^(n+m))G → (I^n).toModules tensor G with a followed by multiplication equal to the ideal-product inclusion.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YB (lemma-homs-over-open), surjectivity paragraphs

proof.text: Compare the recursive idealSheafPower I.toModulesι (n+m) with (I^(n+m)).toModules. Both inclusions are monic, and on every affine open their ranges are I(W)^(n+m), by ideal_times_quasiCoherent_affine_sections and range_toModulesι_app; at exponent zero the inclusion is the identity and the ideal is top. Equality on the affine basis gives equality of the subobjects: the cokernel projection of either inclusion composed with the other vanishes on affines, hence everywhere by sheaf separatedness; kernel.lift and the abelian image factorization give mutual factorizations. The resulting isomorphism p commutes with inclusions. Tensoring p with G and invariance of imageSubobject under precomposition by an isomorphism give a product isomorphism q preserving the inclusions.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YB (lemma-homs-over-open), surjectivity paragraphs

proof.text: Set χ = q.hom followed by a followed by β and take exponent n+m. Functoriality, the restriction formula for β, the multiplication identity for a, and the inclusion identity for q show R.map χ = R.map inclusion followed by the transported ψ. Apply faithfulness of overEquiv U and cancel the component of overFunctorEquiv U at F. Naturality at χ and at the inclusion, together with the isomorphism inverse identities, gives exactly H.map inclusion followed by ψ = H.map χ. All helpers are proved, and no choice is made in a definition.

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_hom_ideal_power_extension {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [CompactSpace X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F G : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U ↔ Function.Surjective
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map I.toModulesι).hom) :
    ∀ ψ : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).obj G ⟶
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).obj F,
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (χ : idealModuleProduct (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2 G ⟶ F),
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map
            (idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2 G) ≫ ψ =
          (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map χ
